paper.title_en: DUNE High Band-Width Data Processing Pipeline
paper.abstract_en: The collaboration between NVIDIA and Fermilab will create a high-bandwidth data processing pipeline which uses state of the art Artificial Intelligence to analyze data generated by Fermilab’s DUNE. The collaboration will enable data generated by the experiment to be analyzed close to the source, reducing networking, storage, and time requirements for offline data analysis. The collaboration will analyze potential current and future hardware solutions enabling real‐time analysis of data, as well as performance analysis and improvements based on the LArCV2 codebase to support the performance of goals of the experiment and associated equipment.
